ACS PUMS variables RAILS uses

Source: R/pums.R
pums_variables.Rd

The Census API variable names fetched by pums_fetch(), with what each is used for. Supplied as a function rather than a constant so it can be printed, subsetted, or extended before being passed back to pums_fetch().

Usage

pums_variables(geography = c("region", "state"))

Arguments

geography

"region" (the default) or "state". The state form adds ST, the state FIPS code.

Value

A named character vector: names are the ACS variable codes, values describe what each contributes.

See also

pums_fetch(), pums_recode().

Examples

pums_variables()
#>                                           PWGTP 
#>                                 "person weight" 
#>                                            AGEP 
#> "age, used for the adult filter and age groups" 
#>                                             SEX 
#>                                           "sex" 
#>                                           HINCP 
#>                      "household income, banded" 
#>                                            SCHL 
#>                "educational attainment, banded" 
#>                                             TEN 
#>            "tenure, banded into own/rent/other" 
#>                                            HISP 
#>                               "Hispanic origin" 
#>                                          RACWHT 
#>                                   "race: White" 
#>                                          RACBLK 
#>                                   "race: Black" 
#>                                          RACASN 
#>                                   "race: Asian" 
#>                                         RACAIAN 
#>        "race: American Indian or Alaska Native" 
#>                                           RACNH 
#>                         "race: Native Hawaiian" 
#>                                           RACPI 
#>                        "race: Pacific Islander" 
#>                                          RACSOR 
#>                         "race: some other race" 
#>                                          REGION 
#>                                 "Census region"
